topics.title: Your home screen
topics.body: The first screen after you sign in. It shows renewals coming up in the next 60 days, at-a-glance totals for your entities, assets and policies, and the status of any requests you have open.

topics.title: Your entities
topics.body: Every entity you hold cover under — yourself plus any businesses or trusts. Each card shows how many assets and policies sit under it. Open one to see its detail.
topics.ask: Where do I see my entities?

topics.title: Entities as cards
topics.body: The same entities shown as cards you can drag to reorder. The order is yours and sticks.

topics.title: Relationships map
topics.body: A diagram of how your entities own or hold one another — who is the owner, who is the trustee. Useful when a business is held by a trust, or an asset sits under a company.
topics.ask: How do I see how my entities connect?

topics.title: Add a business or trust
topics.body: Creates a new entity under your account. Pick a specific type (LLC, revocable trust, and so on) and give it a name. You can add assets to it straight afterwards.
topics.ask: How do I add a business entity?

topics.title: All your assets
topics.body: Every asset across all your entities in one sortable table — value, depreciated value, which entity holds it, and how many policies cover it.
topics.ask: Where do I see all my assets?

topics.title: An asset's detail
topics.body: Everything about one asset: its value and depreciation schedule, the policies covering it, and a coverage analysis showing gaps against what we would expect for that asset type.
topics.ask: How do I check one asset?

topics.title: Add an asset
topics.body: Adds a vehicle, property, watercraft or valuable under one of your entities. Give it a type, a name and a value; your broker binds the cover.
topics.ask: How do I add a new asset?

topics.title: All your policies
topics.body: Every policy across your entities — carrier, renewal date, premium and documents. Sorted by renewal date so the nearest is first.
topics.ask: Where do I see all my policies?

topics.title: A policy's detail
topics.body: One policy in full: coverages and limits, renewal reminders, documents to download, and the form to request an enhancement.
topics.ask: How do I look at one policy?

topics.title: Your requests
topics.body: Enhancement requests you have sent your broker, with where each one has reached: submitted, broker review, underwriting, approved or declined.
topics.ask: How do I check a request I sent?

topics.title: Request an enhancement
topics.body: Asks your broker to change cover on a policy — raise a limit, add an item, adjust a deductible. Your broker reviews it and sends it to underwriting.
topics.ask: How do I ask to change my cover?

topics.title: Your documents
topics.body: Every document attached to any of your policies, in one place, ready to download.

topics.title: Account settings
topics.body: Your name and email, and your renewal-reminder preferences — the address reminders are sent to (shown there, changed by your broker) and how far ahead you want them.
topics.ask: How do I change my reminder settings?

topics.title: Security and privacy
topics.body: How your account is protected and who can see your records: access is by broker invitation, and your entities, assets and policies are visible to you and your licensed broker. One exception, and the Help desk is it: when you ask a question here, your question and a summary of your own records are sent to our AI provider (Anthropic) to answer it. No other client's records are ever included.
